scope: Research and engineering opportunities involving radio sensing, positioning, localization, SLAM, physical state estimation, sensor fusion and calibration, geometric optimization, Bayesian/probabilistic estimation, integrated sensing and communication (ISAC), joint communication and sensing, 6G sensing, and robotics or civilian autonomous driving. Include hands-on algorithm development, real-time deployment and validation roles; C++/Python are useful evidence, not mandatory keywords. For postdoctoral appointments at universities, research institutes and laboratories, prioritize integrated sensing and communication (ISAC), joint communication and sensing (JCAS), and 6G radio sensing with an explicit sensing-communications research link. Generic robotics, SLAM, perception and standalone radar postdocs are secondary references and must not be presented as direct ISAC matches; do not fill the main postdoc shortlist with adjacent roles. This postdoc priority does not narrow the industry job and internship search. Search postdoc, postdoctoral researcher, postdoctoral fellow and equivalent appointments; distinguish them from PhD studentships and thesis projects, and retain PhD-completion, appointment-duration and start-date requirements. Prioritize internships, postdoctoral appointments and PhD-entry roles in the United States and Sweden, Canada outside Québec with no required French or bilingual proficiency, and other European and remote options; retain relevant full-time and experienced individual-contributor roles with their requirements. Record eligibility restrictions without assuming eligibility. Civilian-only opportunities: omit military/defence, national-security and explicitly dual-use roles. Mixed-use employers require role-specific evidence of civilian assignment.
